card.name: Section cross-reference numbers in labels
card.fires_on: Marks inside parenthetical section references in drug labels, such as the opening bracket, the space or first digit of numbers like (2.3, 5.3), and the W of 'see Warnings'. Also fires partway through some drug brand names.

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: The bracket, space or digit inside a numbered cross-reference in highlights text.
modes.example: ( 2 ) Not for oral, ophthalmic, or intravaginal use. (<< >>2 )

modes.label: See Warnings reference
modes.description: The start of 'Warnings and Precautions' after 'see' in a bracketed pointer.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug or brand name.
modes.example: Evaluate patients who develop fever and lung infiltrates or respiratory distress after receiving RYZ<<NE>>UTA for ARDS.
